raw_text: FACT CHECK: Viral images showing 'opposition leaders meeting foreign agents in Dubai' are AI-GENERATED. Alt News investigation found: (1) The images were created using the PolitiMeme AI Generator app (v3.2). (2) The app's watermark is partially visible despite cropping attempt. (3) Error Level Analysis (ELA) reveals uniform noise patterns consistent with AI generation, not camera capture. (4) Facial proportions show classic GAN artefacts at jawline and ear boundaries. (5) The 'Dubai hotel' background is a stock image from Shutterstock. VERDICT: FAKE — AI-generated satirical images shared without context.
clean_text: Alt News fact check confirms Dubai meeting images are AI-generated using PolitiMeme app. Watermark partially visible. ELA shows AI noise patterns. GAN artefacts at jawline and ears. Background is Shutterstock stock image. Verdict: fake satirical images shared without context.
